title: ATR-barrier study, direction readout: the trained TBA / TBB weights with agree score (1 + p_buy - p_sell)/2 -- S1 re-scored, then S2 as a width-book sizer
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); post-hoc readout chosen after S1. Nothing is adopted or promoted.
why: 034's fixed-% triple-barrier model learned volatility (all-bar AUC 0.617 on its own label) but not direction where we trade (candidate AUC 0.525; 0.51 on tbatr) -- research/tb_model/check.json. The ATR-scaled label removes the volatility shortcut; 037 found direction signal on it (composite candidate AUC 0.554 / 0.552 vs ARO 0.541 / 0.539). Arm B asks whether those indicators help a model learn it.
label_definition: framework labels_triple_barrier / _sell with pt = sl = 1e-9, atr_scale 4.0 (ATR(14) Wilder), horizon 48, min_gain / min_loss None, post-label peak filter OFF (LABEL_PEAK_FILTER False, model-key attribute): BUY = up 4xATR first, SELL = down first, HOLD = timeout / tie. Checked before this file: equal to 037's label:tbatr_buy on SOL, 199,152 rows, 0 mismatches
training: per fold f00-f14, research.candidate_training.train --model TBA / TBB (seed 1, cs_aro's params snapshot), TRAIN_ROW_FILTER volume > 0 (last bar of each window); everything else ARO's (architecture, horizon, scaler for ARO's 24 columns)

cs_tba_d.class: NNNC_CS_TBA_D = DirScoreMixin + NNNC_CS_TBA (same weights / model key)

cs_tbb_d.class: NNNC_CS_TBB_D = DirScoreMixin + NNNC_CS_TBB (same weights / model key)
cs_tbb_d.inputs: ARO's 24 + 7 composite members (user_data/data/tb_inputs, table_sha d84f8123ea593215: 037-cache columns, trailing z 2880 / min 960, clip +-5, /5)

s1.rows: test windows f00-f14, tradeable bars (data_ok AND volume > 0), label:tbatr_buy defined (timeouts / ties excluded)
s1.pass: per arm: median gbb-candidate AUC of the direction score above ARO's p_buy AUC in BOTH halves (research/tb_model/dir_arms.py screen)

s2.design: cs_aro's design with the direction score: research/tb_model/dir_arms.py pick (validation-tail width-book run starts, 0.5 share, 4 dp, verified against the arm's sizer_score), 15-fold backtest
s2.instrument: cs_aro's checks (research/hgb_sizer/instrument.fold_checks), tag check against the arm's table with p_buy replaced by the direction score (user_data/data/tb_dir/<arm>/); entries without a score <= 1%
s2.pass: cs_aro's bar: judge_one PASS vs w_aro AND wf_aro_g24 (small-margin rule)
s2.question: judge_one(arm, cs_aro): PASS = both half gains > 0, not WORSENED -- the tbatr-trained sizer beats the current ARO sizer

small_margin_rule: if any primary half gain is < 1 pp, a PASS is INCONCLUSIVE
seen_before: 037 tbatr screens (all halves, all and tradeable bars), composite and its members
cs_aro, w_aro, wf_aro_g24, cs_arov, cs_cmp, cs_mix results
cs_tba's p_buy - p_sell candidate AUC: 0.542 early / 0.563 late (median; ARO 0.541 / 0.539) -- arm A's S1 outcome on this readout is KNOWN; arm B's is not
logistic/HGB direction ceiling on the same inputs (reference.json)
question: read as direction (p_buy - p_sell), does the tbatr-trained model beat ARO where we trade, and is it a better width-book sizer than cs_aro?
amends: preregistration.json (69d250ae): S1 there scored p_buy and both arms failed. Post-S1 diagnostics (report.md, 3f3196a8) showed p_buy tracks barrier hit (volatility); the direction is in p_buy - p_sell. Re-scoring after seeing results was decided by the user (2026-10-17). The original verdicts stand as registered.
